summary: Security VAPT Remediation Testing - Iteration 35. All 10 security findings (V-01 through V-04, V-06 through V-11) verified as remediated.

V-01_bulk_upload_admin_role_blocked.details: Bulk upload with role='admin' in CSV is blocked and forced to 'user'. Error message: 'Role admin not allowed in bulk upload. Set to user.'

V-02_users_see_limited_buildings.details: Regular user (user.test@cebuana.com) only sees their main_building (CL Tower Makati). Admin sees all 8 buildings.

V-03_cors_not_wildcard.details: CORS configuration now parses CORS_ORIGINS env var. get_allowed_origins() function validates and returns empty list for wildcard fallback in dev.

V-06_attendants_assigned_buildings_only.details: Attendant (attendant.test@cebuana.com) with assigned_buildings=['dcae62c5-901a-4bf3-bf7c-c5e116232c93'] only sees NCVI building. Admin sees all 8 buildings.

V-07_api_root_no_version.details: API root /api/ returns {message: 'Parking API', status: 'running'} - no version number exposed.

V-08_csv_injection_sanitized.details: All dangerous prefixes (=, +, -, @) are prefixed with single quote. Normal names unchanged. Verified via 5 pytest tests.

V-09_login_placeholder_generic.details: Email placeholder is 'Enter your email address' - no company domain revealed.

V-10_react_router_upgraded.details: react-router-dom version is exactly 7.13.1 in package.json

V-11_password_ref_based.details: LoginPage.js uses useRef for password input (passwordRef). Password value read via passwordRef.current?.value, not stored in state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (V-09, V-10, V-11 verified via UI test and code review)
